segments.text: This is the word that the LORD spoke through Jeremiah the prophet concerning Babylon and the land of the Chaldeans:

footnotes.text: + That is, the Babylonians; also in verses 8, 25, 35, and 45

segments.text: Announce and declare to the nations; lift up a banner and proclaim it; hold nothing back when you say, ‘Babylon is captured; Bel is put to shame; Marduk is shattered, her images are disgraced, her idols are broken in pieces.’
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: For a nation from the north will come against her; it will make her land a desolation. No one will live in it; both man and beast will flee.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, the children of Israel and the children of Judah will come together, weeping as they come, and will seek the LORD their God.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: They will ask the way to Zion and turn their faces toward it. They will come and join themselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will never be forgotten.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text:
My people are lost sheep; their shepherds have led them astray, 
causing them to roam the mountains. They have wandered from mountain to hill; they have forgotten their resting place.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: All who found them devoured them, and their enemies said, ‘We are not guilty, for they have sinned against the LORD, their true pasture, the LORD, the hope of their fathers.’
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text:
Flee from the midst of Babylon; depart from the land of the Chaldeans; 
be like the he-goats that lead the flock.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: For behold, I stir up and bring against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the land of the north. They will line up against her; from the north she will be captured. Their arrows will be like skilled warriors who do not return empty-handed.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Chaldea will be plundered; all who plunder her will have their fill,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: declares the LORD.
Because you rejoice, because you sing in triumph— you who plunder My inheritance— because you frolic like a heifer treading grain and neigh like stallions,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: your mother will be greatly ashamed; she who bore you will be disgraced. Behold, she will be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text:
Because of the wrath of the LORD, she will not be inhabited; 
she will become completely desolate. All who pass through Babylon will be horrified and will hiss at all her wounds.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Line up in formation around Babylon, all you who draw the bow! Shoot at her! Spare no arrows! For she has sinned against the LORD.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text:
Raise a war cry against her on every side! She has thrown up her hands in surrender; her towers have fallen; her walls are torn down. 
Since this is the vengeance of the LORD, take out your vengeance upon her; as she has done, do the same to her.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text:
Cut off the sower from Babylon, and the one who wields the sickle at harvest time. In the face of the oppressor’s sword, each will turn to his own people, 
each will flee to his own land.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Israel is a scattered flock, chased away by lions. The first to devour him was the king of Assyria; the last to crush his bones was Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says:
I will punish the king of Babylon and his land as I punished the king of Assyria.
segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts

segments.text: I will return Israel to his pasture, and he will graze on Carmel and Bashan; his soul will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.
segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts

segments.text: In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, a search will be made for Israel’s guilt, but there will be none, and for Judah’s sins, but they will not be found; for I will forgive the remnant I preserve.
segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts

segments.text: Go up against the land of Merathaim, and against the residents of Pekod. Kill them and devote them to destruction. Do all that I have commanded you,
segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts

segments.text: declares the LORD.

footnotes.text: + Forms of the Hebrew cherem refer to the giving over of things or persons to the LORD, either by destroying them or by giving them as an offering; also in verse 26.

segments.text: The noise of battle is in the land— the noise of great destruction.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: How the hammer of the whole earth lies broken and shattered! What a horror Babylon has become among the nations!
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: I laid a snare for you, O Babylon, and you were caught before you knew it. You were found and captured because you challenged the LORD.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: The LORD has opened His armory and brought out His weapons of wrath, for this is the work of the Lord GOD of Hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Come against her from the farthest border. Break open her granaries; pile her up like mounds of grain. Devote her to destruction; leave her no survivors.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Kill all her young bulls; let them go down to the slaughter. Woe to them, for their day has come— the time of their punishment.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Listen to the fugitives and refugees from the land of Babylon, declaring in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance for His temple.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Summon the archers against Babylon, all who string the bow. Encamp all around her; let no one escape. Repay her according to her deeds; do to her as she has done. For she has defied the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Therefore, her young men will fall in the streets, and all her warriors will be silenced in that day,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: declares the LORD.
Behold, I am against you, O arrogant one,
segments.speaker: The Lord GOD

segments.text: declares the Lord GOD of Hosts,
for your day has come, the time when I will punish you.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: The arrogant one will stumble and fall with no one to pick him up. And I will kindle a fire in his cities to consume all those around him.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: This is what the LORD of Hosts says:
The sons of Israel are oppressed, and the sons of Judah as well. All their captors hold them fast, refusing to release them.
segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts

segments.text: Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of Hosts is His name. He will fervently plead their case so that He may bring rest to the earth, but turmoil to those who live in Babylon.
segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts

segments.text: A sword is against the Chaldeans, declares the LORD, against those who live in Babylon, and against her officials and wise men.
segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts

segments.text: A sword is against her false prophets, and they will become fools. A sword is against her warriors, and they will be filled with terror.
segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts

segments.text:
A sword is against her horses and chariots and against all the foreigners in her midst, 
and they will become like women. A sword is against her treasuries, and they will be plundered.
segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts

segments.text: A drought is upon her waters, and they will be dried up. For it is a land of graven images, and the people go mad over idols.
segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts

segments.text: So the desert creatures and hyenas will live there and ostriches will dwell there. It will never again be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation.
segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts

footnotes.text: + Literally daughters of an ostrich or daughters of an owl

segments.text: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah along with their neighbors,
segments.speaker: The LORD of Hosts

segments.text: declares the LORD,
no one will dwell there; no man will abide there.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text:
Behold, an army is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings are stirred up
from the ends of the earth.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: They grasp the bow and spear; they are cruel and merciless. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride upon horses, lined up like men in formation against you, O Daughter of Babylon.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: The king of Babylon has heard the report, and his hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped him, pain like that of a woman in labor.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan to the watered pasture. For in an instant I will chase Babylon from her land. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? For who is like Me, and who can challenge Me? What shepherd can stand against Me?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Therefore hear the plans that the LORD has drawn up against Babylon and the strategies He has devised against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the little ones of the flock will be dragged away; certainly their pasture will be made desolate because of them.
At the sound of Babylon’s capture the earth will quake; a cry will be heard among the nations.
